summary: Luda Technology Group Limited filed a Form 6-K with a press release announcing the acquisition of a 4% strategic equity interest in Hong Kong International New Economic Research Institute Limited (INERI) for $1.2 million in cash. The transaction is a minority stake purchase, with no stated premium, board recommendation, or advisors. INERI provides blockchain consulting and tokenization services. The acquisition reflects Luda's interest in blockchain technology integration. The deal is already executed per the SPA, so regulatory or closing timelines are not specified. Watch for any follow-up on blockchain integration plans or further stake increases.
